description: React component implementing an advanced date range picker with relative time options and custom date inputs, utilizing libraries like moment.js and Ant Design icons.

classes.name: AdvancedDatePicker
classes.description: React functional component providing a UI for selecting date ranges with quick relative options and manual date input fields.

methods.name: getMatchingOption
methods.description: Checks if current date range matches any predefined relative time options.

methods.name: validateDateRange
methods.description: Validates the start and end date inputs for correctness and logical order.

methods.name: formatDisplayRange
methods.description: Formats the displayed date range in the button summary.

methods.name: adjustDateRange
methods.description: Adjusts the date range to set start and end times to beginning/end of days, aligning with original component logic.

methods.name: handleRelativeTimeSelect
methods.description: Handles user selection of a relative time preset and updates date inputs accordingly.

methods.name: updateTempValueFromInputs
methods.description: Converts manual date input fields into date objects and updates temporary state for previewing changes.

methods.name: handleApply
methods.description: Commits the selected or input date range to the parent component, applying adjustments for consistency.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Reverts temporary changes and closes dropdown without applying new values.
